headlines.title: Inside Michigan’s critical midterm Senate battle
headlines.description: NBC Nightly News anchor Tom Llamas speaks to Democrat Abdul El-Sayed, Republican Mike Rogers, and voters in Michigan.

headlines.title: Justice Department threatens legal action against California over alleged noncitizen voters
headlines.description: The DOJ demanded election officials review a list of possible noncitizens within 48 hours and “segregate” any mail ballots they sent in.

headlines.title: Feds seized Rep. Ilhan Omar’s phone, subpoenaed family members in immigration status probe
Pope Leo recovers after lung surgery
headlines.description: There are new details about Pope Leo’s recovery following his lung cancer diagnosis. Doctors say he is progressing as expected. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports from Rome.

headlines.title: Eight states sue OpenAI over ChatGPT’s alleged harms to users
headlines.description: Kansas Attorney General Kris Kobach said states “are not going to hold our breath” for federal legislation to keep AI companies in check.

headlines.title: Romance scammers are getting harder to catch. The consequences are costly.
headlines.description: For people looking for love online, a match with a scammer could cost them their life savings.

headlines.title: Trump pardons two vehicle repair shop owners during Alaska rally
headlines.description: During his rally in Alaska, President Trump pardoned Zachary Czuback and Patrick Fleming, co-owners of a vehicle repair shop in Anchorage. Both pleaded guilty in 2022 to violating the Clean Air Act by tampering with federally mandated and monitored devices that tracked vehicles’ diesel emissions.

headlines.title: Advocates fear potential witnesses handcuffed in back of ICE vehicle that struck Houston man could be deported
headlines.description: Nidia Delfín said her brother was handcuffed in the back of the ICE vehicle when it hit a man, adding that he has no arrest warrants and that he was getting his green card when he was arrested.

headlines.title: Trump says government officials who leak to the media ‘should be shot’
headlines.description: The administration has repeatedly sought to crack down on information leaks to the media.

headlines.title: Kentucky police arrest 8 in child abuse, trafficking and rape investigation
headlines.description: The seven victims are ages 1 to 17, police in Richmond said.

headlines.title: A mom vanished after she and her ex-fiancé were on ‘The People’s Court.’ Now he’s accused of murder.
headlines.description: An Orlando man has been arrested in the disappearance of his ex-fiancée, who vanished in 2011 hours after the pair appeared in a pretaped episode of “The People’s Court,” police said.
